title: Rotation and minutes-share table for the 2026-11-17 / 2026-11-18 games (measured, not assumed)
rule: Shares are each player's official minutes divided by the team's total official minutes for that game, computed from the stored game page. top8 = the eight players with the most minutes. Nothing is modelled here; this is what the official box score says happened, which is the empirical base the redistribution model needs. Published beside data/derived/rotation_2026_27.json, not inside it, because the roll owner holds that file (§66 P05).
